mechanism_narrative: Rising labor participation rates signal stronger job market activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or if returns are positive when PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE crosses above 6%, or if returns are negative when UNRATE stays above 6% for 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls AND GDPC1 rises in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when FEDFUNDS falls while GDPC1 rises, or if returns are positive when FEDFUNDS rises despite GDPC1 falling.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS strengthens equity valuations through lower discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or if returns are positive in <40% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO signals robust business activity and production growth, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or if returns are positive when INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 105 signals weakening business activity and reduced growth prospects, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 105 in a month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in <60% of instances when INDPRO drops below 105, or if returns are positive when INDPRO remains above 105.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rises in HOUST (demand) and GDPC1 (demand) indicate strengthening consumer and business demand, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises AND GDPC1 rises in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when HOUST rises while GDPC1 falls, or if returns are positive when either proxy falls despite the other rising.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS signals accommodative monetary policy, which more effectively boosts equity valuations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of recessionary periods, or if returns are positive in <40% of such instances.
